![Green Papaya Salad (Som Tam Malakor) Recipe](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280236-1672-0139-0000-c8abbb417e7f:6)
Som Tam (or Som Tum) is `a vibrant, spicy, and crunchy Thai salad made from shredded unripe (green) papaya` . Originating from the Isan region in northeastern Thailand, the name translates to "sour" (som) and "pounded" (tam), as the ingredients are traditionally bruised and mixed in a clay mortar and pestle.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Green_papaya_salad) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Green_papaya_salad)[[2]](https://thaisq.com/som-tam-more-than-just-papaya-salad-and-why-you-should-try-it-spicy/)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DRJgB-CDIz4/)[[4]](https://www.takeaway.com/foodwiki/thailand/som-tam/)

It is celebrated for hitting all five fundamental taste profiles in a single bite: spicy, sour, salty, sweet, and umami.[](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DRJgB-CDIz4/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/papaya-salad-v3/)

Key Ingredients & Preparation

The core appeal of the dish lies in its balance of flavors and the rhythmic pounding that releases the aromatics.[](https://www.seriouseats.com/som-tam-green-papaya-salad-5208332) [[1]](https://www.seriouseats.com/som-tam-green-papaya-salad-5208332)

- **The Base:** Shredded crisp green papaya, which acts as a refreshing, crunchy canvas that absorbs the dressing.
- **Aromatics & Crunch:** Garlic, fresh Thai bird's eye chillies, cherry tomatoes, and yard-long beans.
- **The Dressing:** A vibrant mixture of fresh lime juice, fish sauce, and palm sugar (or tamarind).
- **Textures:** Roasted peanuts and dried shrimp.[](https://www.seriouseats.com/som-tam-green-papaya-salad-5208332) [[1]](https://rosasthai.com/recipes/papaya-salad)

Common Variations While *Som Tam Thai* (the version with peanuts and dried shrimp) is the most popular globally, there are dozens of regional variations:[](https://www.seriouseats.com/som-tam-green-papaya-salad-5208332) 

- **Som Tam Pla Ra:** The local Isan favorite, made with a pungent fermented fish sauce and sometimes raw salted crab.
- **Som Tam Ponlamai:** A version where the papaya is substituted with mixed fresh fruits like apples, pineapple, or guava.
- **Som Tam Mu Yor:** Features sliced Vietnamese pork sausage alongside the papaya.[](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DRJgB-CDIz4/) [[1]](https://www.travelfish.org/eatandmeet_profile/thailand/bangkok_and_surrounds/bangkok/bangkok/1842)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4EH7UElxrbs&t=11)

How it is Eaten Som Tam is rarely eaten by itself. In Thai culture, it is traditionally served as a communal meal and paired with sticky rice (khao niew) and grilled or barbecued chicken (gai yang). The sticky rice and sweet, savory chicken help temper the sharp tang and fiery heat of the salad.[](https://guide.michelin.com/en/article/features/decoding-the-delicious-som-tam) [[1]](https://guide.michelin.com/en/article/features/decoding-the-delicious-som-tam)[[2]](https://www.travelfish.org/beginners_detail/thailand/97)[[3]](https://gopowerkick.com/1018/som-tam-thai-ped-ped)For a visual guide on the traditional technique and ingredients used to make Som Tam:![](https://encrypted-tbn1.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRr8OkHQ2G08nPEbqmdzksIEdRROmUt5wLg5kMNQPc_y2hxIv8989Z2fwvPAmjVrNy4SXBZzOqpwDRkBmmY3TjLMNg1DQ)

expanded_element.title: What do you know about Somtum, Thai green papaya salad?
expanded_element.description: Som (Thai: ส้ม) which's north-eastern Thai word means sour taste and Tum (Thai: ตำ) means pounding with pestle to crush or break ingredients. Somtum is a distinctive-sour and spicy dish that is made by using a pestle and mortar to crush and mix all ingredients together.
